title: Two-goal Festival
story: Short matches with quick restarts and celebrations.
setup: Two small pitches when numbers allow, 2v2 or 3v3, goals and spare balls.
instructions: Serve a new ball quickly when one leaves.
coach_lens: Observe and say less. Intervene for safety or one short useful question.

challenge: Reduce pitch size before adding rules.
low_attendance: Use one smaller area and repeat short rounds.
high_attendance: Duplicate the area so every player stays involved.
limited_equipment: Use shoes or field markings when cones or goals are unavailable.

safety: Provide equal turns and playing time.

source.title: Practice design in football: two-goal games
source.reviewer_notes: SmallSide-authored delivery and adaptations based on the linked two-goal-game design principles. Version 2 adds standardized delivery metadata and an original SmallSide diagram without changing the activity rules.

questions: What can you do as soon as your team wins the ball?

diagram.alt: Two small pitches each hold a two-versus-two game between goals.
